canonical_statement: Every quasi-finite separated morphism f : X -> Y of schemes factors through an open immersion j : X -> Xbar followed by a finite morphism g : Xbar -> Y.
domain_and_universes: Schemes X and Y in explicit universes to be fixed against the pinned mathlib category API; an existential intermediate scheme Xbar
conclusion: There exist Xbar, j : X ⟶ Xbar, and g : Xbar ⟶ Y such that j is an open immersion, g is finite, and j ≫ g = f.

alternate_encodings.relationship: corollary family, not definitionally the root

excluded_degenerate_cases: No noetherian, reduced, irreducible, birational, or normal hypotheses are part of the selected factorization root unless exact source/API analysis later demonstrates a required convention; corollaries with such assumptions do not substitute for the root.
foundation_profile: rev-5.6 foundation profile not instantiated; classical choice, quotients, and categorical extensionality remain to be audited
tcb_profile: Lean 4 kernel plus pinned mathlib; exact versions and transitive closure remain open

source_revisions: Discovery anchors are recorded in source_statement_crosswalk.md; immutable editions, hashes, and errata receipts remain open
freshness_and_revocation_policy: Invalidate on changes to the selected ZMT formulation, scheme/morphism predicate conventions, Lean target, imports/toolchain, source pins, foundation/TCB policy, or rev-5.6 standard.
